name: Top KingWin Ltd Class A Ordinary Shares
summary: Top KingWin Ltd. is a holding company that engages in the provision of corporate business training, corporate consulting, and advisory and transaction services. It provides customized software development, technology solutions, and peripheral hardware to clients, and focusing on fields such as intelligent manufacturing, urban construction, and healthcare industry. The company was founded by Rui Lin Xu in 2020 and is headquartered in Guangzhou, China.
